paths.description: List of directories/files to process. Each item may include 'path' and optionally 'recursive'.

paths[].path.description: Path to scan for hardlinkable files.

ignore_mtime.description: Ignore modification time when comparing files (matches --no-time).

dry_run.description: Perform a trial run without making changes (matches --dry-run).

debug.description: Print detailed debug info on examined files (matches --debug).

stdin.description: Read arguments (paths) from stdin instead of command line arguments.
